ostrzezenia.tekst: Low-acid foods, with a pH above 4.6, such as beets, cannot be safely canned in a boiling-water bath unless they are acidified according to a tested recipe.

akapity: The FDA list gives peppers a pH of about 4.65–5.45.
Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods have a pH above 4.6 unless the recipe contains enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar.
JarAtlas has found no checked source for the pH of chipotles in adobo sauce, so it is not known whether the mixture is acidic enough for a boiling-water bath.
